**How to falsify it:** Identification of a pathogenic variant in one of the cohesin-related genes (SMC1A, SMC3, NIPBL, RAD21, HDAC8, BRD4, ANAPC7) in a patient with Cornelia de Lange syndrome that exhibits a gain-of-function mechanism, while the other disease requires a loss-of-function mechanism for the same gene. _(variant: A pathogenic allele frequency > 0.01% in gnomAD for any of the core cohesin-related genes, specifically within populations relevant to the described phenotypes.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of the cohesin complex in both Cornelia de Lange syndrome and Ferguson-Bonni neurodevelopmental syndrome could lead to the development of targeted therapies aimed at restoring proper gene regulation or mitigating downstream consequences of cohesin dysfunction.
